Reference / mail/mailbox

mail/mailbox#

Message flags, stored messages and Maildir folders.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let box = Maildir(Path("Mail/inbox")).created();
box.add(message);
for box.messages() -> stored {
    stored::Mail::identifier;
    stored.flags().membership(SystemFlag(SystemMailFlag.seen));
}
ChangedMaildirFlags(origin: box, identifier: id, flags: MailFlags(SystemFlag(SystemMailFlag.seen))).mail();

Description#

Message flags, stored messages and Maildir folders.

A Maildir keeps one message per file in new/ and cur/ and delivers through tmp/, so a reader never sees half a message. Operations take .okkama-maildir.lock (shared to read, exclusive to change). Flags D, F, R, S and T are kept in file names; Recent is not stored. By default a Maildir reads at most 1000 messages and 64 MiB.
